From 7d6203af30b45bb1506e20935a270286c3e2393f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <yongjun_wei@trendmicro.com.cn>
Date: Sat, 7 Dec 2013 14:00:19 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ahci: imx: fix the error handling in imx_ahci_probe()

Release alloced resources instead of direct return from
imx_ahci_probe() in the error handling case.

Fixes: 4a23d1793f8e ('ahci: imx: Add i.MX53 support')
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <yongjun_wei@trendmicro.com.cn>
Signed-off-by: Tejun Heo <tj@kernel.org>
Acked-by: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>

diff --git a/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c b/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c
index 2daa28891b7f..dd4d6f74d7bd 100644
--- a/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c
+++ b/drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c
@@ -331,7 +331,8 @@ static int imx_ahci_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 		if (IS_ERR(imxpriv->gpr)) {
 			dev_err(dev,
 				"failed to find fsl,imx6q-iomux-gpr regmap\n");
-			return PTR_ERR(imxpriv->gpr);
+			ret = PTR_ERR(imxpriv->gpr);
+			goto err_out;
 		}
 
 		/*
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/ata/ahci_imx.c`**
- The error handling in the `imx_ahci_probe` function has been modified. Instead of directly returning the error code from `PTR_ERR(imxpriv->gpr)`, the code now assigns this error code to a variable `ret` and uses a `goto` statement to jump to the `err_out` label for cleanup.

### Relationships
- The modification improves the error handling process by ensuring that allocated resources are properly released before exiting the function, rather than terminating the function immediately upon encountering an error. This change enhances resource management and prevents potential memory leaks or resource locks in the driver.
